summary: Draft rule for loads of 75 MW or greater proposes a security deposit and interconnection fee of $50,000 per megawatt, plus a flat study fee of at least $100,000.

source.citation: PUCT publication of draft rule, March 12 2026

notes: Final SB 6 large-load rule targeted for December 31, 2026. Stated purpose includes reducing duplicate and never-built queue requests
confidence_note: Not finally adopted. Figure is provisional; final rule targeted December 31, 2026.
